paper.title: The CepA disk-outflow system at <=0.2'' or <=100au resolution: Northern Extended Millimeter Array (NOEMA) long baseline data

notes: One of the nearest (~700 pc) high-mass accretion-disk candidates, the protostar HW2 in Cepheus A; the held image is the NOEMA long-baseline (~1700 m) 1.3 mm continuum zoom at <=0.2 arcsec (<=100 au) resolution, shown with 1.3 cm jet contours (Beuther et al. 2026).
